title: Managing Block Storage Volumes
description: Instructions for creating, attaching, and formatting storage volumes.
steps: Go to the 'Storage' > 'Volumes' section in the Console.

content:
## Overview
Expand your instance's storage capacity by adding volumes.

## Prerequisites
- An active Virtual Machine

## Procedure
1. Go to the 'Storage' > 'Volumes' section in the Console.
2. Click 'Create Volume' and specify a size in GB.
3. Select the new volume and click 'Manage Attachments'.
4. Select your active Virtual Machine to attach the volume.
5. Log into your VM to format and mount the newly attached device.

## Troubleshooting
If the volume does not appear in your OS, rescan the SCSI bus or reboot the instance.
